title: The use of artificial intelligence technologies in the European Union
lineage: Short paraphrased notes on official documentation.

passages.locator: p. 13, enterprise AI technologies and notes
passages.note: Page 13 documents the 2025 enterprise indicator scope: programming-code generation was explicitly added and image, video and audio generation was added as a separate AI technology.

Enterprise activity coverage is NACE C–J and L–N plus group 95.1, rather than the whole economy. Individual questions focus on consciously reported generative-tool use during the previous three months; embedded AI may not be captured.
